top_signals.title: Jaguar Land Rover Sales Dented by Supplier Fire and Iran War
top_signals.summary: Jaguar Land Rover Automotive Plc’s revenue tumbled almost 10% in the latest quarter after production at Britain’s largest carmaker was derailed again.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Microsoft’s massive Patch Tuesday releases continue as AI reshapes bug discovery
top_signals.summary: This month’s update features about five times the volume of patches Microsoft was shipping in a typical month before AI-assisted vulnerability discovery took hold.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Air India Orders One-Off Drug Test for Its Over 5,000 Pilots
top_signals.summary: Air India Group will screen its more than 5,000 pilots for psychoactive substances in an unprecedented one-time action, according to an internal email, after a captain allegedly tested positive for illegal drugs following the mid-air plunge of its Phuket-Delhi flight.

top_signals.title: South Korean Fleet Reshuffle Creates Asia’s Largest LNG Carrier Operator
top_signals.summary: South Korean private equity firm Hahn & Co plans to reshuffle the liquefied natural gas tanker fleets of its shipping companies SK Shipping and H-Line Shipping to create Asia’s biggest and the world’s third-largest operator of LNG carriers.   Under the agreement announced by the shipping firms’ owner Hahn & Co on Thursday, SK Shipping will receive 16 LNG carriers and their related long-term contracts from H-Line Shipping in exchange for 12 tankers, long-term contracts, and about $300 million in cash.   …
